MRI Information
MR Conditional (3-Tesla or less): spatial field gradient ≤ 1000 Gauss/cm (10 T/m); slew rate ≤ 150 T/m/s per axis; B1+rms must not exceed 1.7 microtesla; Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode; Integrated Whole Body Transmit Coil.
Image artifact: up to 5 mm.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
